metaTitulo: Open lessons of the School: Revolutionary theory and People's struggles
metaDescricao: The Revolutionary theory and People's struggles lessons of the Lúcia Maria Revolutionary School, open to read, with no account and no sign-up.
lead: All the lessons on these two shelves live in the School and are open: anyone can read any lesson, with no account and no sign-up.
semRastro: Reading without an account leaves no trace: the School does not record who read what. Your progress, notes and saved items stay only on this device, as always.
cadastroTitulo: What the School gives those who study through it
cadastroTexto: Reading is free. Studying through the School is what gives you the guided path (with tests), the certificate, live classes, the class and base group, follow-up from the coordination, entry into the Front and the tag on Alumia.
